Honestly I've seen so many people think that the Pats are gonna really struggle without Tom. And while it's true Tom Brady is a fucking god and helps the Pats out more than any other player. I don't think it'll be as big of a deal considering the schedule, the roster and the backup

The Schedule

  • Only tough game in the first four is Arizona right now. It's an away game at a 13-3 team with a top 2 roster imo. This will probably be a loss around 24-20 or 30-24 where it seems like we're out played
  • After that there's the fish in Gillette and if it were in Miami I'd get it, but this is in Foxborough and with their new coach I really don't see this playing out well for them
  • Texans in primetime but also at Gillette. They have a stacked defence but New England is always a top 10 defence with Belichick. Both will be playing relatively new QBs but ours has many more offensive weapons with Gronk, Bennett, Lewis, Edelman and whoever starts between Amendola/Hogan. Then factor in coaching and home team and I'm not really worried about this game much either
  • Bills in Gillette. Sexy Rex Ryan ain't gonna get his win here. Not in Foxborough. Couldn't be less worried about this game tbh

The Roster

Our secondary last year ranked behind only Denver with two safeties finishing in the top 10, with DMac helping over top & Chung in the box. Butler proved he's more than capable of being a true #1 CB and Logan Ryan while isn't always flawless, is amazing at playing for the ball which lead to a lot of turnovers/batted down passes. The front 7 last year was great but losing Jones will hurt. Long isn't as good as him and that might show up in the Cardinals game. But Hightower back and Collins there are going to make it damn impossible to rush for any of these teams except perhaps the Bills if Shady returns to old form. The offensive line will have all the members healthy as opposed to the end of last season where absolutely none of them were and more importantly our old Oline coach who we always had a top Oline under has decided to come back for this season! Yay! Gronk, Bennett, Minitron and Lewis are all going to be very useful weapons for Jimmy

The Backup

Mr.Garoppolo went in the second round for a reason. His biggest strength is his release. It's damn near perfect. Before the draft everyone was talking about how this guy had Marino's motion perfected. It's his best trait outside of his seriously unfair genetics A lot of people thought he might slip down to the third where teams like the Texans and Raiders were hoping to be able to steal him but Belichick wasn't having any of that. He went so low because he played in Eastern Illinois and he only had his senior year that was truly impressive. But you best believe it was VERY impressive. Every year he improved more and more and then he took a huge leap his final college season where he threw over 5k yards, 53TDs and just 9INTs with 66% completion. Breaking Tony Romo's records at that school by the way. Similar to Tom in looks, is also his work ethic and his brain. I have no doubt he's been learning a lot and continuing to improve. Then every time he's taken the field he's looked impressive. Preseason means nothing but he's lit it up every time he's played in it, the KC massacre in 2014 he played very well but that was garbage time so it doesn't really matter. What I am impressed by is how he played the Bills in Week 17. He only played the second half, and he didn't even put up any points. But he played great. He had only backups with him, and the Bills redhot defence was playing all but one of their defensive starters. And yet if you can find tape on the game watch how he plays. He was very smart in his throws and outplayed both Aaron Rodgers and Peyton Manning against this defence in the weeks prior to this game. I honestly believe you might see a stat line around 62% 7TDs 2INTs and a 3-1 record from him

TL;DR The schedule is pretty easy, the roster is solid and we have a good backup. I don't think the world is falling look for another 12-4/13-3 record and another AFC East title from the Pats
